in_hebrew.name: גדעון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בשם גדעון, שמשמעותו 'מגדל אותם, אלוהים ידיד', נמצא במקרא. השם נזכר בספר שופטים, פרק י', פסוק 1, כגדעון, בן יואש, שהיה זוטא, אבל נכנס להיסטוריה כשאלוהים העביר את אדוני, מלך מואב, לידיו. השם 'גדעון' משמר את דמותו של הגיבור, שגבר על צבא משולש, ובכך, הוא מייצג את האומץ והאמונה של האדם האמיץ. השם 'גדעון' יכול לסגד בשלום, ובעת הזו, הוא נחשב כשם הולם לילד.

in_greek.name: Γιδέων
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιδέων, με την ετυμολογία του 'Μέγας απεσταλμένος, θερμός', ανιχνεύει την αρχική του ρίζα στην Εβραϊκή βιβλική γλώσσα. Στην Βίβλο, ο Γιδέων αναφέρεται ως ο δεύτερος από τα δώδεka ορόφια, ο οποίος ήταν ηγεμόνας του Ισραήλ για τα 40 χρόνια. Ο Γιδέων ήταν ο στρατηγός που οδήγησε την Ισραήλ σε νίκη κατά του Μοαβ, που ήταν ο εχθρός τους για πάνω από 40 χρόνια. Ο Γιδέων, με την ηγεσία και την ευσεβία του, έμαθε στους Ισραηλιτες ότι ο Θεός είναι με τους ανθρώπους και ότι ο Θεός είναι ο μόνος που μπορεί να τους βοηθήσει. Ο Γιδέων, ως όνομα, συμβολίζει την αυτοπεποίθηση, την ηγεσία και την πίστη.

in_latin.name: Gideon
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Gideon, cum suo significatu 'Maior missus, caldus', in Biblia inventum est. Gideon in Biblia ut Gideon, filius Ioas, qui fuit maior, sed in historia Gideon, maior, quia Deus misit eum, ut vinciret Moab, qui erat inimicus populi Israel. Gideon, ut nomen, significat virtutem, fidem et ducem. Gideon, in historia, fuit dux, qui populum Israelam in victorias duxit. Gideon, ut nomen, dux, qui in populo Israelam virtutem et fidem ostendit. Gideon, ut nomen, caldus, qui in amore Dei est. Gideon, ut nomen, maior, qui in populo Israelam virtutem ostendit.

Gideon, as a name, symbolizes the strength, faith and leadership of the mighty warrior. Gideon, in the story, was a leader who led the Israelites to victory. Gideon, as a name, means a leader who shows courage and faith to the people of Israel. Gideon, as a name, is hot, meaning one who is full of love for God. Gideon, as a name, means mighty, meaning one who shows strength to the people of Israel. Today, the name Gideon is considered a fitting name for a child, as it symbolizes the qualities of a brave and courageous person.

data.cultural_impact: Gideon is a biblical name with a rich and profound historical significance, particularly within the Jewish and Christian traditions. As a revered figure in the Hebrew Bible, Gideon's story has been passed down through generations and has been a source of inspiration and courage for those facing obstacles and adversity. The name Gideon has been used in various forms of art, literature, and media, and continues to be a popular choice for parents seeking a name with profound meaning and historical significance.
data.spiritual_significance: Gideon's name is deeply rooted in the spiritual beliefs of the Jewish and Christian faiths. He is remembered as a man of faith and courage who trusted in God's power to deliver the Israelites from their enemies. Gideon's story highlights the importance of trusting in God's guidance and strength, even in the face of overwhelming odds. His name serves as a reminder that with faith and obedience, even the seemingly insurmountable challenges can be overcome. Additionally, Gideon's story is a testament to the power of prayer and the importance of listening to God's voice and following His will.

Gideon's initial reluctance is met with divine signs, and he ultimately defeats the Midianites with an army of 300 men using unconventional tactics.

historical_references.context: After defeating the Midianites, Gideon is approached by the people who demand that he rule over them as their king. Gideon refuses and instead sets up a golden ephod as an idol for the Israelites to worship, bringing about the start of the downfall of the Israelites.

modern_usage.modern_context: Gideon is a prominent figure in the Hebrew Bible and is known for his courage and leadership skills. In the modern context, Gideon's story is often referenced in various platforms to inspire and motivate people in different areas of life. In business and entrepreneurship, Gideon's story of leading a small army against the Midianites with only 300 men is used as an example of overcoming great odds and achieving success against all odds. In religious and inspirational content, Gideon's story of trusting in God's strength and guidance is used as a reminder of the importance of faith and courage in the face of adversity. In education and self-improvement, Gideon's story of leading his people with humility and wisdom is used as an example of effective leadership and personal growth.
